[SWS_SM_00701] Request satellites to enter Suspend Mode
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00402
⌈
When
ara::sm::s2r::S2RHub::RequestToEnterSuspendMode
is invoked,
the
S2R Hub
shall send a message to all actively registered
S2R Satellite
in-
stances (see [SWS_SM_00710]) to enter the
Suspend Mode
by calling the
ara::
sm::s2r::S2RSatellite::EnterSuspendMode
callback.
⌋
